profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at PayPal
profile.summary:
I am a web applications developer that is passionate about building quality software that enriches people's lives.  I primarily work on backend systems in Ruby (Ruby on Rails) while also jumping into frontend development as needed. I have experience building robust systems that communicate via RESTful JSON APIs, gRPC, and message brokers (RabbitMQ).

As a lead+ developer, I architect and own systems, mentor at every opportunity, enforce coding/design standards, and help provide resolution to the gnarliest bugs. I believe that truly successful people elevate the people around them, therefore I value team collaboration over individual advancement.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: As a key contributor on a small platform team, I was responsible for upgrading a legacy app from Ruby 2.4 to 3.0, ensuring compatibility of the monolith's database queries with TiDB (migrating from MySQL 5.7), project lead for migrating a Ruby/Cassandra system to Go, improving observability of platform-owned services, and mentoring team members.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of a very talented and diverse team building a billing system that manages subscriptions, provisions services (our merchant's storefronts and associated services like domains and SSL certificates), and APIs that support account lifecycle management.

Our systems integrate with numerous internal systems over HTTP and gRPC as well as deep integrations with Salesforce and Zuora.

These systems are in the critical on-boarding and upgrade paths of all BigCommerce merchants.

positions.title: Web Developer Team Lead
positions.description:
As a 50% billable role, I worked with clients to configure and customize the Blackbaud Luminate Online application suite to meet their online fundraising goals. 

Additionally, I overcame business obstacles so my team of 5 web developers stayed happy and efficient while providing an excellent client experience. I lead initiatives to define and report on new KPI's for the web development team after the Blackbaud acquisition of Convio, as well as staffing and resource planning, team/department budget planning and team processes.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Enabled non-profit organizations to maximize the amount of money generated through online donations by incorporating web development best practices inside the Blackbaud Luminate Online application suite.

Extended core application functionality via HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery and YUI3.

positions.title: Senior Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
(Pre-Blackbaud Acquisition) 

Enabled non-profit organizations to maximize the amount of money generated through online donations by incorporating web development best practices inside the Convio Luminate Online application suite.

Extended core application functionality via HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery and YUI3.

positions.title: Customer Success Manager
positions.description:
Customer advocate, providing superior enterprise technical support to the largest financial institutions in the country.  
  
* Analyzed and implemented Zendesk customer portal (replacing existing email-only support process).

* Built the foundation for a scalable support organization.

* Identified/reported KPI's.

* Identified automation opportunities to reduce operation costs / improve ticket resolution times.  
  
* Extensive experience troubleshooting customer and technical problems, identifying problem scope and providing detailed reproduction steps.  
  
* Identified and resolved reset password functionality bug in Java/ExtJS source.

* Worked on XML data export transforms.

* Custom reporting engine using the Zendesk JSON API.

positions.title: Support Operations Team Lead
positions.description:
* Implemented Email-To-Case Premium with HTML templates that allowed our customer base to email the support team instead of being required to interact through our self-service Salesforce portal. Cases were automatically created and tracked for the client in our system to provide the best user experience. Email-To-Case provided a holistic forecast of work volume and was instrumental to ensure the hiring model was accurate.

* Developed Salesforce/Trac add-on (GreaseMonkey/jQuery) that saved the Support Team 20 man-hours per quarter using just 2 hours dev time. Ported code to support Jira when ticket management system was changed.

* Developed implementation processes and internal best practices for new products to ensure maximum cross-browser compatibility.

* Utilized front-end web development skills to implement new products and customized solutions for strategic clients including Walmart, Best Buy, Dell, Home Depot, and Bank of America.

* Worked with Project Management/Development teams at some of the world’s largest companies (Walmart, Expedia, BoA, Fnac, Wickes and more).

* Chosen as a peer code reviewer to ensure quality of code being checked into repository.

* Provided support to cross-departmental teams such as Account Managers, Sales, Marketing and Business Development.

positions.title: Implementation Engineer
positions.description:
As an Implementation Engineer, I worked with our client's project team to implement our hosted solution in the client's environment in a seamless fashion.

* Implemented technical solution using XML configuration files and front-end web development best practices.

* Strong client-facing skills to help keep project on time and ensuring the technical team had access to the information they needed.

* Assisted support team in understanding current implementation best practices and helped troubleshoot team member's issues.

honors.title: Bigcommerce Humbitious Award
honors.description: The Humbitious Award recognizes an employee or team of employees who have proven to be Humbitious, meaning they are equal parts humble and ambitious. A Humbitious person focuses on the work, not themselves. They seek success, but they are humbled when it arrives. They feel lucky, not all powerful. They are consistently motivating and focused on team impact, not personal gain.
